findings.current: The Skeleton King’s eyes widened as he caught Jin Taekyung’s arm when it suddenly gave way.
findings.defect: The draft makes Jin’s arm give way; Jin himself staggers, and the Skeleton King catches his arm.
findings.rationale: 휘청거리는 describes Jin Taekyung, not his arm.
findings.replacement: The Skeleton King’s eyes widened as Jin Taekyung suddenly staggered and he caught him by the arm.
findings.source: 순간 휘청거리는 진태경의 팔을 붙잡은 스켈레톤 킹이 눈을 동그랗게 떴다.

findings.current: “Thanks like hell. You son of a bitch, Assistant Hwang……”
findings.defect: “Thanks like hell” can mean Jin is not grateful, reversing his emphatic thanks.
findings.rationale: 조온나게 intensifies 고맙다; the insult follows genuine thanks.
findings.replacement: “Thanks so fucking much, Assistant Hwang, you son of a bitch……”

findings.current: One trembling hand belonged to Chuck Hagel, who was already going through withdrawal.
findings.defect: The draft states that Hagel is in withdrawal instead of preserving that he is pretending.
findings.rationale: 척 marks the withdrawal as a pretense.
findings.replacement: One trembling hand belonged to Chuck Hagel, who was already acting as if he were going through withdrawal.
findings.source: 덜덜 떨리는 손은 이미 금단 현상에 접어든 척 헤이글의 것이었고

findings.current: The unusually small hand, with a great many calluses, belonged to Pai Chen.
findings.defect: The draft uses a different name for the established character Faye Chen.
findings.rationale: The supplied Felix profile establishes Faye Chen as his companion.
findings.replacement: The unusually small, heavily callused hand belonged to Faye Chen.
findings.source: 유난히 굳은살이 많고 자그마한 손은 파이 첸의 것이었다.

findings.current: What was this supposed to mean? What the hell was this supposed to mean?
findings.defect: The draft turns Jin’s self-dismissive reaction to crying into a question about meaning.
findings.rationale: 이게 뭐라고 and 이깟 게 belittle the thing affecting him; they do not ask what it means.
findings.replacement: Why was this such a big deal? Why did this little thing matter so damn much?
findings.source: 이게 뭐라고. 이깟 게 도대체 뭐라고.

findings.current:
“Because a sword……”

“Because a sword.”

“A spear is……”

“A spear is.”

“Cooler.”

“Cooler……Fuck.”
findings.defect: “Because a sword” leaves the repeated punchline grammatically disconnected and changes the comparison Jin begins.
findings.rationale: The source builds one comparison, 검보다 창이 멋있어, through the Skeleton King’s echoes.
findings.replacement:
“Compared to a sword……”

“Compared to a sword.”

“A spear……”

“A spear.”

“Looks cooler.”

“Looks coo……Fuck.”

findings.current:
You have defeated [Lv. 175 Michael Silbert]!
> You have gained a tremendous amount of EXP and Fame!
> You have achieved the rare feat [Cut the Weeds and Pull Up the Roots]!
findings.defect: Square brackets remain around terms inside a System panel, contrary to the packet’s Markdown rule.
findings.rationale: The System heading and blockquote already frame these notices.
findings.replacement:
You have defeated Lv. 175 Michael Silbert!
> You have gained a tremendous amount of EXP and Fame!
> You have achieved the rare feat Cut the Weeds and Pull Up the Roots!

findings.current: The special debuff [Broken Body] rejects the power of healing!
findings.defect: The debuff name retains prohibited square brackets inside the System panel.
findings.rationale: The packet’s System-panel convention identifies UI terms without square brackets.
findings.replacement: The special debuff Broken Body rejects the power of healing!
findings.source: ― 특수 디버프, [부서진 신체]가 치유의 힘을 거부합니다!

findings.current:
You have achieved the unbelievable feat [A Coronation for One Person Alone]!
> The [World Hunter Federation] appoints you as its [Alliance Leader]!
> You have gained a tremendous amount of EXP and Fame!
findings.defect: The final System panel retains square brackets around its feat, organization, and title.
findings.rationale: The packet requires System notices and UI terms to appear without square brackets.
findings.replacement:
You have achieved the unbelievable feat A Coronation for One Person Alone!
> The World Hunter Federation appoints you as its Alliance Leader!
> You have gained a tremendous amount of EXP and Fame!
findings.source: ― 믿을 수 없는 업적, [오직 한 사람을 위한 대관식]을 달성하셨습니다! ― [세계 헌터 연맹]이 당신을 [맹주]로 추대합니다! ― 막대한 경험치와 명성을 획득했습니다!

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it changes Jin’s stumble, reverses the sense of his exhausted thanks, drops Hagel’s pretense, and misses established naming and System-panel formatting.
